requestBody.query: What to do if you suspect a fraud attempt

200.answer: If you suspect a fraud attempt, you should forward any suspicious emails appearing to be from Bell to phish@bell.ca, then delete the email. For suspicious text messages, forward them to 7726 (SPAM) and then delete the message.

snippets.text: * If you receive a suspicious email that appears to be from Bell, forward it to [phish@bell.ca](mailto:phish@bell.ca)then delete the email. * If you receive a suspicious text or multimedia message, forward it to 7726 (SPAM) then delete the message.
snippets.title: How to protect yourself from fraud

agentUtterance.text: If you suspect a fraudulent email from Bell, forward it to phish@bell.ca, then delete it. If you suspect a fraudulent text, forward it to 7726 (SPAM), then delete it. You can also contact Bell directly to confirm. Could you please let me know if your query is answered?
